info.title: Protomaps Basemap PMTiles
info.description: Free vector map tiles of the Protomaps Basemap, zoom 0 to 15, served as a single PMTiles archive. Clients fetch the archive with HTTP GET requests and HTTP Range requests. No authentication is required.

get.summary: Fetch the PMTiles archive or a byte range

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: HTTP byte range, for example bytes=0-16383.

206.description: Partial content response for a range request.
